title: Asiad: Blu Girls cruise past Thailand to claim second straight win
summary: The Philippines picked up their second straight win in the 20th Asian Games softball tournament after shutting out Thailand, 7-0, on Tuesday at the Anjo Softball Grounds in Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
